g.text: High-Density Optical Indication Matrix • Dedicated 5kHz Hardware PWM Timers (LEDC Ch 0–5) • LDR Synchronous Auto-Dimming • Boot Strapping Protection
• PWM Frequency: 5.0 kHz (Zero audible coil whine & flicker-free)
• Resolution: 8-Bit (256 discrete duty-cycle steps from 0 to 255)
• Execution: Pinned to Core 1 FreeRTOS real-time hardware engine
• Dimming Source: Continuous exponential feedback from LDR on ADC1
• Power LED Behavior: Constant ON with dynamic ambient brightness
• Wi-Fi LED Behavior: Breathing pulse (connecting), Solid (connected)
• Status LEDs 1–4: Exact hardware mirror of Relays 1–4 with auto-dimming
• Total LED Current at 100%: ~28.6 mA (all ON) / Night: ~1.7 mA
✔ MTDO Boot Strapping Safe (Pulled LOW by 220Ω)
✔ CRITICAL: MTDI Boot-strap 330Ω Pull-Down ensures 3.3V flash
✔ Mirrors on-board blue LED / Breathing Wi-Fi status
• V_FLASH Strapping: LOW at boot = 3.3V flash; HIGH at boot = 1.8V flash.
• Safety Guarantee: Active-HIGH Power LED (330Ω to GND) pulls pin to 0V at boot.
• Eliminates risk of flash LDO brownout and permanent MCU boot-looping.
• Controls ROM bootloader UART output silencing on reset.
• 220Ω resistor + Status LED 2 pulls line to 0V during initial power rail ramp.
• Clean boot guaranteed with zero floating silicon states.
• Must be left LOW or floating during boot to enter flashing/running modes.
• Wi-Fi LED circuit acts as passive pull-down, ensuring 100% flashing reliability.
• Dual function: Drives external indicator & reflects internal DevKit blue LED.
TOTAL PEAK CURRENT (ALL 6 ACTIVE): 28.6 mA ◄──► NIGHT SLEEP: 1.7 mA
